description: This file provides utility support methods for safely retrieving nullable and defaulted values from JDBC ResultSets within the Fineract project, including handling date/time types and numerical data with null or zero defaults.

classes.name: JdbcSupport
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for extracting various data types from JDBC ResultSet objects with null and zero handling logic.

methods.name: getDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves a ZonedDateTime from a ResultSet column, returning null if the value is SQL NULL.

methods.name: getLocalDate
methods.description: Retrieves a LocalDate from a ResultSet column, returning null if the value is SQL NULL.

methods.name: getLocalTime
methods.description: Retrieves a LocalTime from a ResultSet column, returning null if the value is SQL NULL.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves a Long value from a ResultSet column.

methods.name: getInteger
methods.description: Retrieves an Integer value from a ResultSet column.

methods.name: getIntegerDefaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Retrieves an Integer value from a ResultSet column; returns null if the value is zero.

methods.name: getLongDefaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Retrieves a Long value from a ResultSet column; returns null if the value is zero.

methods.name: getBigDecimalDefaultToZeroIfNull
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal from a ResultSet column; defaults to BigDecimal.ZERO if null.

methods.name: getBigDecimalDefaultToNullIfZero
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal from a ResultSet column; returns null if the value is zero.

methods.name: getOffsetDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves an OffsetDateTime from a ResultSet column, adjusting for timezone offsets.
